name: Sticky Lemon-Pepper Wings with Creamy Kale & Brussels Sprout Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 260°C (500°F). Coat two baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Divide between the baking sheets and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken wings, split with tips removed
2 tbsp cornstarch
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ bunches kale
0.68 kg Brussels sprouts

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into a clean large bowl. Juice lemons into another large bowl and set aside for the wing sauce.
Add mayo, oil, Dijon, salt and pepper to the bowl with the lemon zest; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice Brussels sprouts. Add to the bowl.
Using your hands, massage the greens with dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes. Set aside.
Add honey, pepper, and salt to the bowl with the lemon juice, then whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup honey
1 ½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the wings are done, remove from the oven. Add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: chicken wings, split with tips removed
